title: Being obsessed with a chart
summary: He works on a chart even in sleep and wakes with answers, as he did with commercials.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: When you’re in the middle of a chart are you obsessed with it?

Yes. Yes I am. As a matter of fact I’m totally obsessed with it, and then you know your subconscious is always working on it, so when I go to sleep at night it’s still working on that chart and when I get up in the morning I’ll have an answer or I’ll have something. I used to do that with TV commercials. I got so competent that I knew I had a jingle in the morning, I couldn’t make it work for me at night so I would just go to sleep, wake up knowing that I would have the answer in the morning. Now this isn’t rocket science and it isn’t some famous symphonic work, this is a jingle. But your mind works on that stuff. It totally works on it. And there’s always an answer.
